Vulkan SDK components, version 1.3.268.0, copied from the local official SDK installation.
Upstream: https://vulkan.lunarg.com/sdk/home#windows

Included: Vulkan/vk_video headers, x64 vulkan-1.lib, glslc.exe, and SDK license files.
The Vulkan runtime/graphics driver is supplied by the operating system's GPU driver,
not bundled here. glslc is a build tool and is never loaded by the triangle apps.
